key_insight: A dependency-aware greedy scheduler can exploit fine-grained parallelism in multi-core quantum circuits to significantly reduce execution time.
engineering_relevance: For multi-core quantum hardware, better gate scheduling can improve core utilization and hide communication latency, directly boosting system throughput.
method: Baseline: layered scheduling executes all gates in a layer in parallel, then moves to the next layer.
Proposed: greedy scheduling launches each gate as soon as its dependencies and resources are ready.
Focus: schedule across cores with awareness of data dependencies and resource availability.
evidence_signal: On real benchmarks, greedy scheduling reduced makespan by about 40% on average and improved core utilization.
watch_item: Results depend on accurate dependency/resource modeling, and gains may vary with hardware communication costs and benchmark structure.
paper_title: Dependency-Aware Circuit Scheduling for Multi-Core Quantum Systems to Minimize Makespan
